instruction: Use mp_api (MPRester) to query the phonon band structure of mp-149 using the NEW API: `mpr.materials.phonon.get_data_by_id('mp-149')` (do NOT use the deprecated `mpr.phonon` interface). If the result is None or unavailable, treat the maximum phonon frequency as None. Save the result to C:\Users\Docker\Desktop\setup\output_result\mp\mp_task_13.txt in the format: `max_phonon_frequency: {value}` (e.g. `max_phonon_frequency: None` if unavailable).
